text_block_list.name: Air Shakur's Record
text_block_list.text:
/*Destiny does not change. No matter how 
much absolute merit I accumulate, the 
public judges relatively... The stigma of 
the "Weakest Generation" will not fade.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur's Record
text_block_list.text:
Once again, Parcae showed a fate where I 
would never win another race. Given the 
current situation, it makes sense. But—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur's Record
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer tells them to make their pride 
known. A vague concept. But to prove their 
strength to everyone... they have no 
choice but to do it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur's Record
text_block_list.text:
After returning home, a baffling 
phenomenon occurs. "Parcae" prompted an 
initialization of itself. 
Incomprehensible, nonsensical—is this 
sci-fi?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur's Record
text_block_list.text:
And yet somehow, I "know." Her reality and 
my reality. The time has come to part 
ways—*/
